rule: Names: 1-3 syllables from start, (vowel+middle) repeated, end; biome name chosen by region area (lake >200 tiles Lake/Loch, >10 tiles Pool/Well/Pond, grassland >750 tiles). Towns: weighted roll (house 64, guard tower 5 dead, field 25, workshop 5 with a minimum, airship 15 gated on size >0.125, tavern 15 gated on size >0.125 and fewer than 2, barn 5), size*200 rounds, each placement tries a bounded number of times, a failed house becomes an open plaza. Plot size = base + spread*u^5 (rounded), so most plots take the base size. Spots: attempts = ceil(tiles*freq/1000^2), each attempt probes one point snapped to a 4-chunk grid, kept only if its condition holds and no site is there; spawn-off zeroes tree density and spawn rate on that chunk.

data_fields.name: spot_freq
data_fields.unit: attempts per km2 of tiles (unit depends on tile size)

keep: Weighted plot roll with minimums, caps and gates held as data
A failed placement leaves an open square, which can be the fight space
Area-based naming threshold: the name tells the size of the land
Spots as encounter templates with a count range and a radius
change: Remove the dead guard tower roll (places nothing; lines 1366-1385) and the unreachable castle arm (entry commented out at 1273, arm at 1393)
Workshop minimum must not take over every roll while none is placed (site/mod.rs 1289)
Draw one name per name, not two (civ/mod.rs 897-904 draws both and keeps one; later seeded draws shift)
Move spot kinds into data: spots.ron holds one entry, 20 kinds are hard-coded
State the unit of spot frequency in the data field (spots.ron comment says per 1000 km2, code comment says per km2)
look_test: Town grey-box at 375 wide: one zone, three seeds, same biome; show plaza, roadside plots, one tavern, one field. Dom judges whether a zone reads as a place at a glance and whether the open square works as a fight space. Second: ten region-grammar names beside ten current Frankendom zone names as phone titles; Dom picks the tone.
